account.funding: exact final funding_rate immediately preceding each crossed funding_timestamp from Bybit derivative_ticker
account.winner_removal: remove ceil(10% of positive 12bp event keys before complete global-slot rerouting

development_gate: same prediction and economic rules, at least 60 trades, positive on at least two of three dates for both delays

event.candidate_threshold: 99th percentile of train-window absolute Coinbase displacement divided by prior one-hour realized volatility
event.entry: first fresh Bybit BBO after completed Coinbase window plus delay
event.target_stop: frozen prior completed Bybit five-minute high and low

fit_gate_all_required.positive_symbol_breadth_18bp: both BTC and ETH or one symbol with >=40 trades

model.baseline: structure-only standardized logistic using target distance, stop distance, range position and prior Bybit volatility
model.calibration: one isotonic map fitted only on calibration rows when both classes are present

scientific_question: Does completed Coinbase spot displacement and aggressor-flow state add incremental information beyond frozen Bybit range geometry for deciding whether Bybit reaches the same-direction external boundary before the opposing boundary?
smc_ict_translation: Coinbase completed displacement defines institutional delivery direction.
The prior completed Bybit five-minute high and low are frozen external liquidity.
Bybit underreaction inside that range is intermarket SMT/non-confirmation.
ML only accepts or rejects continuation toward the Coinbase-direction boundary.
